alreadyDone: Rust mobile core already owns pairing validation, chat send/streaming, tool-call state, session state, model change confirmation, reconnect intent/effects, reload status handling, approval state/effects, notification event surfacing, semantic tree scenarios, replay traces, and simulator automation.

Swift iOS host already links the Rust FFI bridge, dispatches many server events into the Rust reducer, includes a Settings diagnostics section, notification authorization/status plumbing, QR/pairing repair, sessions, models, and gateway health checks.

The PRD open gaps are stale for M1/M2/M4 in several places; the real local gap is not first implementation but reconciling docs with verified behavior and tightening diagnostics/reconnect state so future work targets APNs/Live Activities/physical-device beta accurately.
audit.selectedSlice: Tighten the locally-verifiable diagnostics/reconnect slice and update the PRD/handoff so M1 shared-core parity is no longer treated as open. Specifically: add focused tests for server event parity where missing, ensure diagnostics do not overclaim APNs/physical-device work, update PRD milestones/current-state/next-slice, and record handoff evidence under .context.

risks: Physical iPhone/live gateway acceptance still pending.
Generic simulator build still requires an x86_64 simulator slice in JCodeMobileCore.xcframework or an arm64-only build setting.
implementation.summary: Implemented shared-core mobile diagnostics/model/reconnect parity for current server events; updated Swift bridge and Settings diagnostics; refreshed PRD and local handoff.
verification: xcodebuild -project ios/JCodeMobile.xcodeproj -scheme JCodeMobile -destination generic/platform=iOS Simulator ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES build

verification.command: cargo test -p jcode-mobile-core && cargo test -p jcode-mobile-sim && cargo check -p jcode-mobile-core -p jcode-mobile-sim && swift run --package-path ios JCodeKitTests && git diff --check
verification.summary: Verification chain passed: jcode-mobile-core 62 tests, jcode-mobile-sim 3 tests, cargo check passed, JCodeKitTests 166 assertions, git diff --check clean.
